component.name: ShareX
component.summary: Screen capture, file sharing and productivity tool

p.em: Note: This is an unofficial, community-driven Linux port of ShareX by jocost4. Upstream ShareX is originally created and maintained by the ShareX Team (Jaex).

description.p: ShareX is a free and open source program that lets you capture or record any area of your screen and share it with a single press of a key. It also allows uploading images, text or other types of files to many supported destinations.

ul.li: Various capture methods including full screen, window, region, and screen recording
Advanced image editor and annotator with arrows, shapes, blur, text, and speech balloons
Over 80 different image, text, and file hosting destinations
Custom uploader support and URL shorteners
Productivity tools: color picker, screen color picker, ruler, image splitter, and QR code generator/decoder
Native Linux desktop integration supporting Wayland and X11 through modern desktop portals and Avalonia UI

description.p: Updated with upstream ShareX v22.4.0 features and Linux fixes:

ul.li: Offline PaddleOCR ONNX engine support for text recognition
Real-time region capture coordinate & size indicator
Automatic cleanup of portal screenshot temporary files in user pictures
Support for Wayland and X11 desktop environments via XDG Desktop Portals

description.p: Initial Linux port powered by Avalonia UI and .NET 10.
